title: Codex custom agent
description: Standalone custom-agent file under .codex/agents/*.toml. Required fields are name, description, and developer_instructions; any config.toml key may also be set because Codex loads these files as a config layer.

name.description: Agent name Codex uses when spawning or referring to this agent. Source of truth even if it differs from the filename.

description.description: Human-facing guidance for when Codex should use this agent.

developer_instructions.description: Core instructions that define the agent's behavior.

nickname_candidates.description: Candidate nicknames for spawned agents of this role.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers available to this agent.
